shots.action: Every surface turns into soft plasticine, the woman, the car and the desert gaining thumbprints and seams, and the motion steps into the jerky rhythm of stop-motion as she gives a little wave.
shots.sound: Squishy clay sounds and a cheerful plucked melody.

end.paint: Rebuild the whole image as a handmade claymation stop-motion miniature: a plasticine woman with visible thumbprints, a chunky clay car, clay road, clay desert hills and a painted clay sky, soft studio lighting. Keep the same composition, pose and colours.
